gotchas: No register map exists. I grepped all four Volthium rack/pack manuals plus the dongle and Smart Bridge manuals for register addresses, function codes or CAN IDs: zero hits. Volthium publishes transport, pinout, baud and DIP settings and nothing else. reports and accepts are therefore empty — not because the pack report

The pack does not speak a Volthium protocol. DIP 2-3 (RS-485) and DIP 6-7 (CAN) select which third-party inverter protocol the BMS *emulates*. RS-485 protocol IDs: 0 = Voltronic/MPP/Alpha outback/Phocos/Kodak, 1 = Sol-Ark/SRNE, 2 = LUX power, 3 = Schneider. CAN protocol IDs: 0 = Victron/SMA/Studer Innotec/Sofar, 1 = So
Only the master battery's Protocol ID is set; slaves keep the default. A new DIP sequence needs a restart to take effect.

RS-485 RJ45 pinout: 1 = RS485-B1, 2 = RS485-A1, 3 = SGND, 6 = SGND, 7 = RS485-A1, 8 = RS485-B1 (A and B appear on two pin pairs). CAN RJ45 pinout: 3 = SGND, 4 = CAN-H, 5 = CAN-L, 6 = SGND. Pins 1, 2, 7, 8 are unused on the CAN port.

The BMS terminates BOTH ends of the CAN bus internally. The 51.2 V manual says so explicitly: "The BMS inside the battery pack will automatically terminate BOTH end of CANBUS pins, DO NOT ..." — adding an external terminator will over-terminate the segment.
